criteria.criterion: One gate runner serves both the driver and vloop task gate; there is no second code path that starts a gate.
criteria.evidence: state.GateCommand (internal/state/gate.go) is used by RunGate (internal/cli/task_gate.go:47) and by Iterator.runGate in internal/driver/iterate.go; the driver's own LookPath/exec.Command was removed.

criteria.criterion: The runner refuses a shell outside sh, bash, pwsh, powershell, cmd with exit 1 and exactly `vloop: shell <name> is not one of sh, bash, pwsh, powershell, cmd`, and runs nothing.
criteria.evidence: GateCommand returns UnknownShellError before LookPath or any exec; the gate script checks exit 1, the exact stderr line and that the verify did not run, and it passed (GATE OK in gates/T6.log).

criteria.criterion: For cmd on Windows the command line is passed verbatim as `/C <verify>`; the builder of that command line is a pure function tested on every OS.
criteria.evidence: GateCmdLine is pure; gate_cmdline_windows.go sets SysProcAttr.CmdLine, and gate_cmdline_other.go is a no-op elsewhere. The windows build and vet pass.

criteria.criterion: The runner's package holds TestGateRefusesUnknownShell (shell python3: the refusal) and TestGateCmdCommandLine (the builder yields `/C findstr "a b" f`), each failing against the base; the existing task gate and gate-environment tests still pass.
criteria.evidence: Both tests are in internal/state/gate_test.go and use symbols that do not exist at base. The existing tests were not modified, and the gate passed.
